description: Programs that pay owners for company records (email, chat, tickets, docs, CRM, databases) or private code, including from closed or winding-down companies. Returns each program's summary, who qualifies, published payout range or rates, countries and its Dataconto page. Programs listed on Dataconto's buyer pages come first.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166 code of the owner's country, e.g. US, GB, DE. Programs with no country limit are included.

kind.description: pays_owner = the program pays the owner itself; marketplace = it places the data with buyers; invite_only = no open intake.

listed.description: true = only programs on Dataconto's buyer pages and fit check.

min_payout.description: Only programs whose published payout reaches at least this many US dollars.

side.description: company = business records, code = private source code.

name: list_buyers
title: List who buys company records and code
